panels.title: Pairs with failures (15m)

panels.description: The single worst pair per protocol, over a 15m window so a pair that just went silent does not read as 0/0. This is the quantity the *ChecksFailing alerts threshold on.

targets.expr: max(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total[15m])) >= 0) or vector(0)

max(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total[15m])) >= 0) or vector(0)

max(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total[15m])) >= 0) or vector(0)

max(sum by (source_node, host, resolver) (increase(kconmon_ng_dns_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, host, resolver) (increase(kconmon_ng_dns_results_total[15m])) >= 0) or vector(0)

panels.description: Failed probes over all probes, summed across the whole fleet. A fleet-wide denominator is never zero, so these lines have no NaN gaps.
panels.title: Fleet failure ratio by protocol

panels.description: Fleet averages hide a single broken link. This tracks the worst individual pair, which is what the alerts fire on. Dashed line marks the 5% alert threshold.

targets.expr: max(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total[15m])) >= 0) or vector(0)

max(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total[15m])) >= 0) or vector(0)

max(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total[15m])) >= 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst pair failure ratio by protocol

panels.description: Ranked by failed TCP/UDP/ICMP probes in the last 15m. Every column is an instant query pinned to the same topk(10) pair set, so the rows line up. 15m rather than 5m: a pair that stops being probed entirely makes a 5m rate 0/0.

targets.expr: sum by (pair) (label_join(topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))), "pair", " -> ", "source_node", "destination_node"))

sum by (pair) (label_join((sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", "")) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))), "pair", " -> ", "source_node", "destination_node"))

sum by (pair) (label_join(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total[15m])) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))), "pair", " -> ", "source_node", "destination_node"))

sum by (pair) (label_join(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m])) / sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total[15m])) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))), "pair", " -> ", "source_node", "destination_node"))

sum by (pair) (label_join(avg by (source_node, destination_node) (avg_over_time(kconmon_ng_udp_packet_loss_ratio[15m])) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))), "pair", " -> ", "source_node", "destination_node"))

sum by (pair) (label_join(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (source_node, destination_node, le) (rate(kconmon_ng_udp_rtt_seconds_bucket[15m]))) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))), "pair", " -> ", "source_node", "destination_node"))

sum by (pair) (label_join(sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_mtr_triggered_total[1h])) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_tcp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "tcp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_udp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "udp", "", "") or label_replace(increase(kconmon_ng_icmp_results_total{result="fail"}[15m]), "proto", "icmp", "", ""))), "pair", " -> ", "source_node", "destination_node"))

panels.title: Top 10 worst pairs (last 15m)

panels.description: p95 across every pair, per protocol.
panels.title: Fleet p95 latency by protocol

panels.description: Slowest individual links. A pair that appears here and in the worst-pairs table above is a path problem, not a busy endpoint. The 10 pairs are picked ONCE, by p95 over the whole dashboard range pinned with @ end(). A bare topk() inside a range query is re-evaluated at every step and returns the union of everything that was ever in the top 10 — on a 10-node mesh that is all 90 pairs, each drawn only for the steps it happened to lead.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (source_node, destination_node, le) (rate(kconmon_ng_udp_rtt_seconds_bucket[5m]))) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (source_node, destination_node, le) (rate(kconmon_ng_udp_rtt_seconds_bucket[$__range] @ end()))))

panels.title: Top 10 pairs by p95 UDP RTT

panels.description: The gauge UDPLossHigh alerts on. Dashed line marks the 50% alert threshold. The 10 pairs are picked ONCE, by their worst loss over the whole dashboard range pinned with @ end(), so the same ten lines run edge to edge instead of the union of every pair that ever led at some step.

targets.expr: kconmon_ng_udp_packet_loss_ratio and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, max_over_time(kconmon_ng_udp_packet_loss_ratio[$__range] @ end()))

panels.title: Top 10 pairs by UDP packet loss

panels.description: ICMP loss carries the same peer labels as UDP loss. Loss on both usually means the path; loss on one usually means the probe. The 10 pairs are picked ONCE, by their worst loss over the whole dashboard range pinned with @ end(), so the same ten lines run edge to edge instead of the union of every pair that ever led at some step.

targets.expr: kconmon_ng_icmp_packet_loss_ratio and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, max_over_time(kconmon_ng_icmp_packet_loss_ratio[$__range] @ end()))

panels.title: Top 10 pairs by ICMP packet loss

panels.description: DNS is not pair-scoped: it is keyed by the queried host and the resolver. Dashed line marks the 5% DNSChecksFailing threshold.

targets.expr: (sum by (host, resolver) (rate(kconmon_ng_dns_results_total{result="fail"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (host, resolver) (rate(kconmon_ng_dns_results_total[5m]))) / sum by (host, resolver) (rate(kconmon_ng_dns_results_total[5m]))

panels.title: DNS failure ratio by host and resolver

panels.description: Resolution latency. A rising p95 with a flat failure ratio is a resolver under load, not a broken one.
panels.title: DNS lookup duration by host and resolver

panels.description: An agent triggers a trace when a pair degrades, so this is an independent confirmation that a link is bad. Traces themselves are in the console MTR Explorer. The 10 pairs are picked ONCE, by total traces over the whole dashboard range pinned with @ end(), so the line set does not churn from step to step.

targets.expr: sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_mtr_triggered_total[15m])) and on (source_node, destination_node) topk(10, sum by (source_node, destination_node) (increase(kconmon_ng_mtr_triggered_total[$__range] @ end())))
